scope: OSS runtime; guarantees apply only to listed routes and configured backends

controls.title: Named outbound operations
controls.threat: An agent redirects credential-bearing requests or expands an approved operation
controls.invariant: A selected capability binds tool, origin, method, path boundary, typed manifest inputs and the exact prepared request
limitations: Opt-in through an operator-owned outbound profile
An allowed upstream can still misuse data; destination restrictions are not general data-loss prevention
Retained workflow evidence covers the installed CLI and local fixtures; other listed routes require separate qualification

controls.title: Runtime-held credentials with explicit source selection
controls.threat: Credentials leak to a worker or a failed store causes unintended fallback
controls.invariant: The configured source is the only source; secrets are injected in the runtime and exact reflected values are rejected before delivery
limitations: Trusted runtime and host administrators can access credentials
Encoded or transformed reflection is not comprehensively detected
The external secret store controls credential rotation and expiry
Retained workflow evidence covers the installed CLI and local fixtures; other listed routes require separate qualification

controls.title: Execution-scoped outbound authority
controls.threat: A cancelled or replaced execution reuses authority or resets request allowance
controls.invariant: Run identity and trusted context bind one assignment epoch; cancellation tombstones prevent recreation and uncertain attempts retain charges
limitations: An admitted request may already have remote effects when cancellation arrives
Static upstream credentials remain valid until the upstream revokes them
This is runtime assignment authority, not a remote worker certificate system
Retained workflow evidence covers the installed CLI and local fixtures; other listed routes require separate qualification

controls.title: Durable effect intent and uncertain-outcome inspection
controls.threat: An interrupted outbound effect is reported complete or replayed without reconciliation
controls.invariant: Required signed intent precedes dispatch; incomplete effects remain distinguishable from confirmed completion
limitations: A verified signed prefix is not proof of a complete run
This catalogue does not itself verify an audit journal
Retained workflow evidence covers the installed CLI and local fixtures; other listed routes require separate qualification

controls.title: Independent denial of worker network access
controls.threat: Untrusted code bypasses runtime outbound mediation
controls.invariant: Governed workers use a network-denied boundary and retain only explicit broker channels
limitations: Landlock is Linux-only and shares the host kernel
This branch does not include separate unmerged registered-agent Landlock admission changes
Listed test drivers are not current-build qualifications until results are attached

controls.title: Durable logical workflow resume
controls.threat: Restored state reuses old authority or repeats an irreversible effect
controls.invariant: Resume would require verified state, current authorization and reconciliation of unknown effects
limitations: Not delivered by the optional outbound feature
The existing saga recovery helper re-executes pending steps and is not a safe default for uncertain irreversible effects
